title: chore(devx): state the react-page-adapter rot record as data and retire its held allowance row (#15765)
body:
Part of #15765 — the card stays open: the second held allowance row (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`) is behind governed PR #15724 and is deliberately untouched here.

PR #15806 landed the `scripts/**` symbol-anchor corpus with **two dated `HELD_FILE_ALLOWANCES` rows** for files that live PRs held. PR #15770 landed at 08:08Z, so **one of them is now free** — and an allowance nobody retires is an exemption wearing a date. This PR retires it.

## What changed

**1. `scripts/check-react-page-adapter-contract.mjs` — the rot record is now stated as DATA, not as anchors.**

The paragraph's four dated readings are moved into a small table whose **file and line are separate cells**, so no `path:NNN` token remains:

| the reading | file | line |
|---|---|---|
| the citation as first written | `packages/client/src/index.ts` | 310 |
| the #15094 census found it at | `packages/client/src/index.ts` | 392 |
| triage read, the same day | `packages/client/src/index.ts` | 390 |
| the second citation, as written | `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` | 659 |

⛔ **No number is repaired or repointed.** They are readings taken on a date; the paragraph's argument (one cross-file line citation rotted twice inside a single day, which argues against citing a line at all rather than for repointing it) is unchanged, and its ⛔ line still declares every number a record rather than a pointer. Only the spelling changed.

One clause was updated because the corpus made it false: the paragraph used to say `scripts/**` is outside every symbol-anchor corpus so *nothing resolves these for you*. Since #15806 something does — which is precisely why the anchor spelling had to go — so the paragraph now says that, and says an anchor-shaped number here is judged and reds. Its file-level anchors resolve (`packages/client/src/index.ts` and `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` are both tracked).

**2. `scripts/check-scripts-symbol-anchors.mjs` — the row is deleted.** The `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` row stays, dated and named to PR #15724. The header does not count rows, so no header text needed changing.

**3. The self-test battery floor moves 34 → 30, and the reason is recorded next to the number.** Four of the battery's cases are registered **per allowance row** (the exactness loop runs four `check()`s over each row), so retiring a row lowers the floor by exactly 4. That is now written beside the literal as the *only* admissible reason to lower it — any other drop is cases that stopped running. This is a mechanical consequence of the mandated deletion: without it `--self-test` cannot be green, which the ruling requires.

## Measurement

Exit codes captured **before** any pipe (`cmd > file 2>&1; E=$?`), verdict lines quoted from the runs themselves.

**(a) Base (`cc5b3dd0c`), row present — green.**

```
⏳ [line-anchor] scripts/check-react-page-adapter-contract.mjs:133  packages/client/src/index.ts:310
      a line number is not an anchor form — cite the symbol (`packages/client/src/index.ts#symbol`) or drop to a file-level anchor
      ALLOWED, dated 2026-09-05 — held by PR #15770 (#15599). Delete the row when the citation goes.
✅ check-scripts-symbol-anchors: 2730 anchors across 218 scripts resolve — … 0 line anchors on tracked targets survive (99 citations name no tracked file and are not judged; 2 dated allowance finding(s)).
```
`EXIT=0`

**(b) ABLATION — row deleted, paragraph UNREWRITTEN: the gate reds and names the file.** Trap-guarded (`trap restore EXIT INT TERM`), absolute paths resolved from `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, mutation proved **on disk before the run** and restore proved **byte-identical after**, never by an exit code.

- on-disk proof, before → after: rows naming `check-react-page-adapter-contract.mjs` **1 → 0**; the `adr-0087` row still **1**; anchor-form citations in the target paragraph **1** (unrewritten). Blob `dd894c71…` → `914c7a80…` (a no-op mutation would have aborted the run).
- ablated production run, `ABLATED_EXIT=1`:

```
❌ check-scripts-symbol-anchors: 1 finding(s) across 218 scripts.

  [line-anchor] scripts/check-react-page-adapter-contract.mjs:133  packages/client/src/index.ts:310
      a line number is not an anchor form — cite the symbol (`packages/client/src/index.ts#symbol`) or drop to a file-level anchor
```

- ablated `--self-test`, `ABLATED_SELFTEST_EXIT=1` — and this is where the floor reading came from:

```
❌ check-scripts-symbol-anchors --self-test: self-test battery "check-scripts-symbol-anchors self-test" registered 30 case(s), below its pinned floor of 34 — cases that used to run no longer do.
```

- restore: `RESTORED=dd894c71217803ded4ef95d1bfd8736f5d350952` (equal to the HEAD blob), `git diff HEAD` empty → `RESTORED-OK`.

**(c) Final tree — all four runs green.**

```
✅ check-scripts-symbol-anchors: 2736 anchors across 218 scripts resolve — 21 symbol (21 declaration, 0 literal), 2714 file-level, 0 cross-repo, 1 exempt, 2 continuation. 0 line anchors on tracked targets survive (96 citations name no tracked file and are not judged; 1 dated allowance finding(s)).
```
`EXIT=0` — one allowance finding left, the governed one, still printed and still counted.

```
✅ check-scripts-symbol-anchors --self-test: every finding class provoked, comment-prose projection wired, declined shapes counted not missed, allowance rows exact both ways, population live (2736 live anchors)
```
`EXIT=0` — including check 5, which reds if a row names a file that no longer carries a judged finding.

The edited file is itself a gate, so it was run too:

```
✓ check-react-page-adapter-contract: 21 app-showcase page module(s) + 1 content/docs react-page sample(s) (from 396 doc file(s), 1958 fenced block(s)) — every adapter query option is $-prefixed, every row read is off `data`, and no find() result is tested for array-ness.
```
`EXIT=0`

```
✓ check-react-page-adapter-contract --self-test: 51 assertions — all THREE detectors observed FIRING and observed silent, …
```
`EXIT=0`

Deltas between (a) and (c) are all in the expected direction: `2730 → 2736` anchors (the table's file paths resolve as file-level anchors), `99 → 96` citations naming no tracked file (the three bare readings stop being citations at all), `2 → 1` dated allowance findings.

## The rest of the battery

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --changed --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` — `EXIT=0`, change set 2 paths vs merge base `cc5b3dd0c`, **31 commands derived and every one run and MEASURED GREEN — 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, reconciled by the tool itself rather than by arithmetic over my own list:

```
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 31 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
```

Two commands did not measure on the first pass and neither was reported as a result:

- **seven** were dependency-blocked in a fresh worktree (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, exit 3, and one `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) — `check-reference-carrier-shape` (+self-test), `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+self-test), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check:driver-memory-census`. `pnpm install --offline` (5.7s) then measured all seven green, e.g. `✓ comment-mask corpus sweep [scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs]: 5996 files, 0 disagree, 0 unparseable, 63.5s (comparator self-test: 17 cases pass).` — the one that reads the very comment prose this PR edits.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` first read `EXIT=124`. That was **my own 300s cap, not a verdict**; re-run uncapped on its own recorded PID it reaches `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1493 cases pass.` `EXIT=0`.

Other readings:

- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` `EXIT=0`, plus an independent `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` over both edited files, exit 1 (no matches).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test <final file list>` → `✅  NOT governed — ordinary queue landing applies to a PR with exactly this file list.` (`0 of 2 path(s) hit the register`), run on the FINAL list.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` after a fresh fetch → `EXIT=0`, clean (against `origin/main` `6c439f2b4`).
- Collisions: all 31 open PRs enumerated via `GET /pulls/N/files`; **none touches either edited file**. PR #15724, whose held row stays, touches `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` only.
- Verify lock read before starting: `state: lock is free`, `queue: empty`. No lock-eligible run was needed — this card builds and tests nothing.

Scripts-only diff, nothing published from any released package → `skip-changeset`, applied additively and read back.
